text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was a press day for Marvelous Sunday.
It was supposed to be an interview about
the design of her racing outfit, but—

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding the photoshoot, um...
I'm sorry, but could you strike a pose
that shows off the design...?"

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, that sounded like something
straight out of a fashion magazine, didn't it? Sorry..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...?
Staff member, did you just—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: âAh, watch out!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right?! You're wobbling pretty badly...!
Did you bump into anything?! What about your legs—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine!
More importantly, the photoshoot... even though Senpai went out of her way to pick me as her running partner...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We can pause the shoot for a bit, it's fine.
In fact, if it was becoming a burden to you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems there was almost a collision during
Air Groove and the others' photoshoot.
Just as I breathed a sigh of relief seeing no one was hurt...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —That's it☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: We can just run together one more time! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous...!?
Weren't you in the middle of your own photoshoot?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And Air Groove and the others are filming too☆★
So let's the three of us run together☆★

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The three of us? ...I have no problem with that,
but are you sure you're okay with it?

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah... y-yes.
As long as I can take a photo for now, too...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you get good shots, okay?☆
I know it's gonna turn out MARVELOUS!★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright☆★☆★
Both of you, get in position~☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ready, set, GO☆★☆
Hyahhーー!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆★☆ So fun, feels so good!
Let's run to our heart's content! With total confidence★☆★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...!
Have... confidence—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, forget about the rest... I'm running...
to become someone I can be proud of...!"

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
A-And across the goal!! Amazing...!
What an incredible run from all three of them...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, this girl is strong.
I must not waver or hesitate either—I must remain the 'Empress'—"

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
...T-This is it... This is the shot
I've been looking for...!!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I've been feeling so frustrated!
I felt like there had to be a better way than just taking photos of the racing outfit designs!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yup☆★ I could tell your heart was feeling clouded☆★☆★
That's why I wanted to propose a marvelous picture☆
choice_data_list: So that's why you wanted to run alongside them.
So that's why you wanted to run together, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think that Air Groove and the others' photoshoot
and my own interview would both be resolved
just by running side by side...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Flowers have bloomed in everyone's hearts☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Besides, having people actually "see" it in person
is the best way to convey the feelings put into a racing outfit! ☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Everyone carries a wonderful seed in their heart!
And I want to help them bloom into flowers☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I want them to realize
how Marvelous they truly are☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"That is what I run for☆★
That's the feeling poured into this racing outfit!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: The world and its people are full of marvels!
The world and its people are full of marvels, aren't they!
Yeah, I'll do everything I can to support you.
Yeah, I'll support you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: The world and its people are full of marvels!
The world and its people are full of marvels, aren't they!
Yeah, I'll do everything I can to support you.
Yeah, I'll support you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the very core of Marvelous Sunday's philosophy.
I tell her how glad I am that she got to experience it today.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, both you and I are Marvelous☆ Always cherish your true feelings★☆★

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
I'm marvelous too... So this is marvelous...!
I-I'll cherish it! These feelings of mine...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later—the published interview included
a note from the reporter, who was deeply fascinated by Marvelous Sunday's philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, having you by my side makes me feel so reassured, Trainer☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna make the whole world bloom,
so just watch me!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take in that marvelous view together!
Yeah, let's see a marvelous view together!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
The two of you share such a strong bond...!
If it's alright, I'd love to publish a picture of you both!
May I take a photo of the two of you together?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse!
Marvelouuus☆★☆★
